name: Canvas Jumbotron
description: Ships a ready-made Jumbotron (hero/banner) code component for the Canvas / Experience Builder page builder.
project_description: Canvas Jumbotron is a small, config-only add-on for the Canvas / Experience Builder page builder. Installing it registers a single reusable code component named 'Jumbotron' — a hero/banner region built from a React (js_component) source that exposes three editable slots (Header, Button, Footer) plus an optional Image prop bound to a Media image entity reference. Editors drop the component onto a Canvas page and fill the slots with other Canvas components; the image is chosen through the Media Library and rendered responsively via the canvas_parametrized_width image style. The module contains no PHP, routes, services, or permissions of its own — it is purely the two Canvas config entities (canvas.js_component.jumbotron and canvas.component.js.jumbotron) shipped in config/install.
